film: Ep04 — LEVEL 881 「窗之庭院」The Courtyard of Windows

format.notes: Dry voice only. No reverb, music or effects; peaks under -3 dBFS; trim silence to ~50 ms. Effects (radio, distance) are added in the mix.

archivist.role: M.E.G. archivist narrating the recovered logs (same narrator in every episode)
archivist.voice: Adult, neutral-to-low voice, any gender. Flat, clinical, measured. Must be the SAME voice as the archivist in earlier episodes.

fassbender.role: Lt. Fassbender, leader of M.E.G. team Owl-Eyes (Regiment Compass Point). Records the logs on his helmet camera. The last survivor.
fassbender.voice: Man, early 40s, low and controlled, a soldier keeping his voice level for the record. Becomes hoarse, exhausted and quietly frightened by the end — but never screams.

owl2.role: Owl-2, team member. Practical, a bit of dark humour at first.
owl2.voice: Man, around 30, mid-pitched, heard over a tactical radio.

owl3.role: Owl-3, team member and analyst. Precise, counting things. Disappears during Log 3 — later her voice comes back over the radio from under the floor.
owl3.voice: Woman, around 30, clear and precise, heard over a tactical radio.

lines.speaker: archivist
lines.subtitle: 远征记录 881。指南针点团，「猫头鹰之眼」小队。二〇一七年一月进入。没有人回来。
lines.en: Expedition record 881. Regiment Compass Point, team Owl-Eyes. Entered January 2017. No one came back.
lines.tts_text: 远征记录，八八一。指南针点团，「猫头鹰之眼」小队。二〇一七年一月进入。没有人回来。
lines.direction: Clinical. A slight pause before the last sentence.

lines.speaker: fassbender
lines.subtitle: 「日志一。我们进来了。全员四人。」
lines.en: “Log one. We’re in. Four of us.”
lines.tts_text: 日志一。我们进来了。全员四人。
lines.direction: Quiet, professional, slightly out of breath from climbing through.

lines.speaker: archivist
lines.subtitle: Level 881，「窗之庭院」。生存难度：五级。
lines.en: Level 881, “The Courtyard of Windows”. Survival Class 5.
lines.tts_text: 八八一层，「窗之庭院」。生存难度，五级。
lines.direction: Report tone; a weight on 五级.

lines.speaker: owl3
lines.subtitle: 「我数到……十二个。十二扇不是窗户的窗户。」
lines.en: “I count… twelve. Twelve windows that aren’t windows.”
lines.tts_text: 我数到……十二个。十二扇，不是窗户的窗户。
lines.direction: Counting under her breath, then uneasy.

lines.speaker: archivist
lines.subtitle: 墙上大约有一两百扇窗。其中四分之一到几乎全部，已经被「窗户实体」取代。
lines.en: There are a hundred to two hundred windows. Between a quarter and nearly all of them have been replaced by Window entities.
lines.tts_text: 墙上大约有一两百扇窗。其中四分之一到几乎全部，已经被「窗户实体」取代。

lines.speaker: owl2
lines.subtitle: 「那边有张桌子。还有个钟。」
lines.en: “There’s a table over there. And a clock.”
lines.tts_text: 那边有张桌子。还有个钟。

lines.speaker: fassbender
lines.subtitle: 「日志二。入口窗户……不见了。」
lines.en: “Log two. The entry window is… gone.”
lines.tts_text: 日志二。入口窗户……不见了。
lines.direction: Controlled, but the pause shows it.

lines.speaker: owl2
lines.subtitle: 「这块地板是空心的。撬不开。」
lines.en: “This floor is hollow. Can’t get it open.”
lines.tts_text: 这块地板是空心的。撬不开。

lines.speaker: archivist
lines.subtitle: 中央的白桦木圆盘是空心的。它不是出口。
lines.en: The birchwood circle at the centre is hollow. It is not an exit.
lines.tts_text: 中央的白桦木圆盘是空心的。它不是出口。

lines.speaker: fassbender
lines.subtitle: 「桌上有一台留声机。还有一本《了不起的盖茨比》。」
lines.en: “There’s a gramophone on the table. And a copy of The Great Gatsby.”
lines.tts_text: 桌上有一台留声机。还有一本，《了不起的盖茨比》。

lines.speaker: fassbender
lines.subtitle: 「日志三。大概过去了四个小时。……三号不见了。」
lines.en: “Log three. About four hours. …Owl-3 is gone.”
lines.tts_text: 日志三。大概过去了四个小时。……三号，不见了。
lines.direction: Tired. The last sentence very quiet.

lines.speaker: owl2
lines.subtitle: 「桌子自己挪到中间去了。窗户……全都换了位置。」
lines.en: “The table moved itself to the middle. The windows… they’ve all moved.”
lines.tts_text: 桌子自己挪到中间去了。窗户……全都换了位置。

lines.speaker: archivist
lines.subtitle: 如果音乐响起，立刻离开中庭。
lines.en: If music begins, leave the atrium immediately.
lines.tts_text: 如果音乐响起，立刻离开中庭。

lines.speaker: fassbender
lines.subtitle: 「走！那边有扇门——」
lines.en: “Move! There’s a door—”
lines.tts_text: 走！那边有扇门——
lines.direction: Urgent command, louder than anything else he says.

lines.speaker: archivist
lines.subtitle: 桃花心木门后，是刺眼的白色走廊。门会锁上，楼梯会消失。
lines.en: Behind the mahogany doors: harshly lit white corridors. Doors lock. Stairs vanish.
lines.tts_text: 桃花心木门后，是刺眼的白色走廊。门会锁上，楼梯会消失。

lines.speaker: owl2
lines.subtitle: 「……队长，前面有人。穿着粉色的裙子。」
lines.en: “…Lieutenant. Someone up ahead. In a pink dress.”
lines.tts_text: ……队长，前面有人。穿着粉色的裙子。

lines.speaker: archivist
lines.subtitle: 无面者。不要靠近。
lines.en: A faceling. Do not approach.
lines.tts_text: 无面者。不要靠近。

lines.speaker: fassbender
lines.subtitle: 「附录。只剩我了。」
lines.en: “Addendum. It’s just me now.”
lines.tts_text: 附录。只剩我了。

lines.speaker: archivist
lines.subtitle: 如果被困：遮住自己，保持不动，蒙上眼睛，堵住耳朵。忽略一切声音和幻象，持续六到八小时。
lines.en: If trapped: cover yourself. Stay still. Blindfold and muffle yourself. Ignore every sound and apparition, for six to eight hours.
lines.tts_text: 如果被困，遮住自己，保持不动，蒙上眼睛，堵住耳朵。忽略一切声音和幻象，持续六到八小时。

lines.speaker: fassbender
lines.subtitle: 「不是真的。不是真的。不是真的。」
lines.en: “Not real. Not real. Not real.”
lines.tts_text: 不是真的。不是真的。不是真的。
lines.direction: Whispered to himself under a blanket, fast and shaky, like a prayer.

lines.speaker: owl3
lines.subtitle: 「……队长？我在下面。地板下面。」
lines.en: “…Lieutenant? I’m down here. Under the floor.”
lines.tts_text: ……队长？我在下面。地板下面。
lines.direction: Calm and friendly, which is the wrong way to sound. Slightly too slow.

lines.speaker: fassbender
lines.subtitle: 「……我把眼罩摘了。」
lines.en: “…I took the blindfold off.”
lines.tts_text: ……我把眼罩摘了。

lines.speaker: fassbender
lines.subtitle: 「这本书……字不对。每一行都不对。」
lines.en: “This book… the words are wrong. Every line is wrong.”
lines.tts_text: 这本书……字不对。每一行，都不对。

lines.speaker: archivist
lines.subtitle: 最后几段记录显示，剩下的队员都穿过了木地板。或者，不再出声。
lines.en: The final logs show the remaining members going through the wooden floor. Or simply falling silent.
lines.tts_text: 最后几段记录显示，剩下的队员都穿过了木地板。或者，不再出声。

lines.speaker: archivist
lines.tts_text: 不要进入窗之庭院。
lines.direction: The page's own warning. Slow, cold, every syllable separate.
